notes: Used by SC-12 and FW-07. toolingDistributions: WSL distributions created by container tools, listed but not warned about. portProcesses: processes that publish ports for virtual machines and containers; a listening socket they own on a non-loopback address is reported as a published port. maxVmFilesPerInventory: how many virtual machine files named in one user's VMware or VirtualBox inventory an audit run as SYSTEM or elevated reads (1 to 10000); the rest are reported in SC-12 and FW-07, which are then Manual.
